faqs.a:
Except as provided in this section, hearings conducted under this article shall be
               open to the public. Hearings held pursuant to
section 70-170
, upon request of the petitioner, may be closed to the public except as to officials,
               witnesses, and representatives of the city.
(Code 1981, § 2-140; Ord. No. 3608, §§ 1, 2, 4-3-2003;
Ord. No. 4049, § 1, 1-8-2007
)
